title: Corwin / Cain redraw: three options (nothing installed yet; pick one or none)
current_says: Stiff pose, the bow reads as a stick, a pale fan of arrow feathers behind his shoulder, the toy an orange blob on his chest.

finalists.label: A. FULL DRAW, TOY RIDING ON HIS BACK
finalists.says: Lunging at full draw, arrow nocked. The plush Emberpup peeks over his shoulder from a pack; felt flame on its tail.

finalists.label: B. STRIDING, BOW READY, TOY RIDING ON HIS BACK
finalists.says: Walking fast, bow held out upright; the same plush peeking over his shoulder. No quiver shows in this one.

finalists.label: C. FULL DRAW, TOY HANGING AT HIS HIP
finalists.says: Wide stance at full draw; the plush hangs from his belt, facing out with two button eyes and a cream belly.
